Orange Pill Run: the rules

  1. Round. One round each UTC day, from 00:00 to 24:00 UTC. No new attempt starts in the last 5 minutes of a round.
  2. Level. The level is the previous UTC day's Bitcoin chart: 48 candles of 30 minutes, BTC-USD from Coinbase. Everyone plays the same level.
  3. Free to play. Free to play. 5 attempts a day, your best counts. The best player with a linked X account and a valid Lightning address wins 10,000 real sats.
  4. Attempts. At most 5 attempts per player and round. A run is sent within 10 minutes of its start.
  5. Score. The server replays your inputs and scores the run itself. Your best score of the round counts.
  6. Speed. Faster finishes score much more: 20 points for every second under the level's par time. Sats, stomps, the flag (100) and the day high (50) count too; a run without a hit scores ×1.5. A run that misses the flag gets no time bonus.
  7. Tie-break. On equal scores the shorter run time ranks higher, then the earlier submission.
  8. Play bounty. 10,000 sats, in real sats, each round. The play bounty goes to the best player with a valid Lightning address saved by one hour after the round. No X account and no valid Lightning address: no play bounty.
  9. X account. To be placed and win, link your X account with its code (the same link as the bug bounty) before your first run of the round; it can be verified until one hour after the round. A player without one is not placed; the next player moves up.
  10. Humans only. Humans only. Bots, scripts, automated or assisted play are excluded.
  11. Fair play. Any exploit or cheat disqualifies: changing the game or its data, more than one account, playing for someone else, abusing a bug instead of reporting it. Found a bug? Report it in the bug bounty.
  12. Review. We review the top runs. Every payout is checked and approved by us before it is sent. Our decision is final.
  13. Real sats. The play bounty is paid in real sats and can end or change at any time.
